0.0: Howdy! I am the Laaaaaady Moon Bunny. I want to tell you something.

yes.0: Here's the thing. It's my job to look out for little baby suns while they're still learning to churn up the fire within them. But... well, I maybe wasn't really paying attention and...
yes.1: I think the little tykes are hiding with monsters. So here's my deal I'll give you something from the moon if you bring me 100 #b#e#i3994691##t3994691##k#n items.
yes.2: Make sure the monsters you hunt aren't 11 or more levels below you, or 21 or more levels higher than you. Otherwise they won't be carrying any #b#i3994691##t3994691##k.

no.0: Are all humans cold hearted like you?

yes.0: One...two...hey you brought all 100! I must give you something for finding all of #b#i3994691##t3994691##k. How about a nice new badge? There are still many #b#i3994691##t3994691##k remaining in the world. Go find them again next time!
